title: Satie: piano strings, guitar strings
question: How does a plucked guitar carry the held melody and changing sevenths of Satie’s piano piece?
intro: Robin Alciatore plays Satie’s piano original in a source dated approximately 2008; Michael Laucke’s guitar source is dated 23 July 2001, neither date establishing the recording session. Laucke adapts the bass, chords and held melody to six strings in A rather than D, so the alignment compensates for five semitones without altering playback. The map covers both complete files, 183.61 and 171.89 seconds, with provisional median confidence 0.954; the sparse opening and final decay are less secure than the middle phrases. Compare phrase spacing and the survival of held tones, not raw volume or identical voicings.

passages.note: Keep the earlier close in memory as the second ending changes the harmony. Listen to the upper line as well as the bass.
